## Context / Problem

`make lint` fails when a git-ignored per-session scratch directory (`.rebar/scratch/`, the path AGENTS.md prescribes; ignored by `.gitignore:23: .rebar/*`) holds files the repository does not own. Observed 2026-11-03 in worktree `fix-langur`: a reproduction venv at `.rebar/scratch/a85e3cd3-langur/nonedit-venv` made `make lint` exit 2 with SC2050 in `site-packages/virtualenv/activation/bash/activate.sh`.

The cause is a class, not one script. Four `make lint` gates walk the whole tree and skip only a hand-written directory-name list, so they also judge git-ignored files. Measured 2026-11-03 at `0e7401446c5` by planting one ignored violation per gate under `.rebar/scratch/a85e3cd3-salamander/` (all 26 `python scripts/...` lint steps exit 0 on the clean tree):

- `scripts/check_shellcheck.py:55` `discover` uses `root.rglob("*.sh")` minus `EXCLUDED_DIRS` (line 34): an ignored `bad.sh` exits 1 (SC2050/SC2154).
- `scripts/check_templatefile_escapes.py:201` `check_repo` uses `root.rglob("*.tf")`, and `resolve_template_path` (line 170) resolves templates with `root.rglob(...)`: an ignored `main.tf` plus a template with an undeclared `${...}` exits 1.
- `scripts/check_user_data_size.py:209` `check_repo` uses `root.rglob("*.tf")` with the same `EXCLUDED_DIRS`: an ignored `main.tf` plus a 24 KB template exits 1.
- `scripts/check_uv_pin.py:404`/`412` `_dockerfiles`/`_compose_files` use `root.glob("**/Dockerfile*")` and `**/compose*.y*ml` minus `SKIPPED_SCAN_DIRS` (line 70): an ignored `Dockerfile` and `compose.yml` naming `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest` exit 1 with 2 findings.

The other 22 lint steps and ruff did not react: they scan `src`/`tests`/`scripts`/`infra`/`docs` or fixed paths.

## Approach

Follow the existing precedent in `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`: `_git_tracked_relatives` (line 171) lists `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z` when `root / ".git"` exists, and `iter_repository_files` (line 208) falls back to `_walk_repository_files` (line 218) otherwise. Git's own ignore rules then decide what the repository owns, for any ignored directory name.

Add one shared stdlib-only helper, `scripts/_repo_files.py`, exposing `files_named(root, patterns, excluded_dirs) -> list[Path]`. It returns sorted absolute paths whose file name matches any `fnmatch` pattern and whose repo-relative parts do not intersect `excluded_dirs`. Inside a git work tree (`root / ".git"` exists and `git ls-files` exits 0) the candidates come from that `git ls-files` call; otherwise, including when git is missing, it falls back to the current `rglob` walk. It does not filter symlinks or non-files; each caller keeps its existing filters. The 4 scripts replace their `rglob`/`glob("**/...")` calls with `files_named`, keep their existing exclusion sets (so behaviour outside git is unchanged and the existing temp-dir tests keep passing), and add a `sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))` sibling-import line where missing, the pattern `scripts/check_user_data_size.py:71` already uses. `check_criteria_vocabulary.py` is left as is.

Rejected: adding `.rebar` to each exclusion list. That still scans an ignored directory under any other name.

## Scope

- `scripts/_repo_files.py` (new): `files_named`.
- `scripts/check_shellcheck.py`: `discover`; also correct the `EXCLUDED_DIRS` comment that claims agent scratch is never linted.
- `scripts/check_templatefile_escapes.py`: `check_repo` and `resolve_template_path`.
- `scripts/check_user_data_size.py`: `check_repo`.
- `scripts/check_uv_pin.py`: `_dockerfiles`, `_compose_files`.
- Tests: `tests/unit/test_check_shellcheck.py`, `tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py`, `tests/unit/test_user_data_size_a68c.py`, `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py`.

## Testing

Each of the 4 test modules gains tests that build a temporary git repository (`git init`, a `.gitignore` containing `.rebar/*`, `git add` for tracked files), with child processes started through `tests/_subprocess_env.subprocess_env`. Helpers stay module-local (no new `tests/_*.py` helper, no autouse fixture). No test creates a real virtualenv. Per script:

- an ignored violation under `.rebar/scratch/x/` is not reported, and the gate passes;
- the same violation as a tracked file is still reported (positive control);
- the same violation as an untracked, non-ignored file is still reported.

Plus one direct test of `files_named`, in `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py`: inside git it returns only tracked and non-ignored untracked matches; outside git it falls back to the walk with the exclusion set applied. The ignored-file tests are written first and must fail on `0e7401446c5`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `tests/unit/test_check_shellcheck.py` has a temp-git-repo test asserting `discover` omits an ignored `.rebar/scratch/x/bad.sh` that carries a shellcheck warning, while still returning a tracked and an untracked non-ignored copy; it fails before the fix and passes after.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py` has a temp-git-repo test asserting `check_repo` reports nothing for an ignored `.rebar/scratch/x/main.tf` whose template has an undeclared `${...}`, and still reports the tracked copy; it fails before the fix and passes after.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_user_data_size_a68c.py` has a temp-git-repo test asserting `check_repo` measures no call site from an ignored `.rebar/scratch/x/main.tf` with an oversized template, and still measures the tracked copy; it fails before the fix and passes after.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` has a temp-git-repo test asserting `check_dockerfiles` and `check_compose_images` report nothing for an ignored `.rebar/scratch/x/Dockerfile` and `compose.yml` using `uv:latest`, and still report the tracked copies; it fails before the fix and passes after.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_check_shellcheck.py tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py tests/unit/test_user_data_size_a68c.py tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` exits 0.
- [x] With the 4 measured ignored violations planted under `.rebar/scratch/<session>/` again, plus a copy of virtualenv's `activation/bash/activate.sh` (the originally observed SC2050 file), `make lint` exits 0 with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on `PATH`.
- [x] `make typecheck` exits 0.
